"""Run and bind exact CPU proofs for the five added stopped cases."""
from __future__ import annotations

from hashlib import sha256
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[1]
MANIFEST = HERE / "execution-manifest.json"
DECODER = ROOT / ".runtime-work/fire-decoder/.lake/build/bin/adapterCheck"
TARGETS = [("stopped_drive_to", 500), ("stopped_drive_to", 550),
           ("stopped_park", 450), ("stopped_park", 500), ("stopped_park", 550)]


def digest(path):
    return sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def run(args, destination):
    with destination.open("w") as stream:
        subprocess.run(args, cwd=ROOT, stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True)


def main():
    manifest = json.loads(MANIFEST.read_text())
    targets = TARGETS[2:] if "--park-only" in sys.argv else TARGETS
    names = (["authorized_emergency_at500"] if "--exception" in sys.argv
             else [f"{branch}_{target}ft" for branch, target in targets])
    for name in names:
        case = f"{HERE.name}__{name}"
        folder = HERE / "cases" / name
        entry = next(item for item in manifest["cases"] if item["case_id"] == case)
        for ident, row in [("primary", entry),
                           *[(item["id"], item) for item in entry["candidates"]]]:
            work = ROOT / ".runtime-work" / f"proof-{name}-{ident}"
            if work.exists():
                shutil.rmtree(work)
            work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            offline = work / "offline"
            compatibility = work / "compatibility"
            offline_log = folder / f"{ident}-offline.log"
            compat_log = folder / f"{ident}-compat.log"
            print(case, ident, flush=True)
            run([sys.executable, "runtime.py", "offline", "--manifest", str(MANIFEST),
                 "--case", case, "--candidate", ident, "--output", str(offline),
                 "--python", sys.executable], offline_log)
            run([sys.executable, "runtime.py", "compatibility", "--manifest", str(MANIFEST),
                 "--case", case, "--candidate", ident, "--output", str(compatibility),
                 "--library", "runtime/library", "--validator", str(DECODER)], work / "compatibility-command.log")
            receipt = folder / f"{ident}-compatibility.json"
            negative = folder / f"{ident}-negative.log"
            shutil.copyfile(compatibility / "compatibility.json", receipt)
            shutil.copyfile(compatibility / "compatibility-analysis.log", compat_log)
            shutil.copyfile(compatibility / "negative-analysis.log", negative)
            result = json.loads(receipt.read_text())
            if not result["passed"] or result["candidate_id"] != ident:
                raise ValueError(f"Compatibility failure: {case} {ident}")
            row["offline"] = {
                "command": f".venv-cpu/bin/python runtime.py offline --manifest work/{HERE.name}/execution-manifest.json --case {case} --candidate {ident} --output .runtime-work/FRESH --python $PWD/.venv-cpu/bin/python",
                "exit_code": 0, "log": offline_log.relative_to(HERE).as_posix(),
                "log_sha256": digest(offline_log),
                "construction_sha256": row["construction_sha256"]}
            row["compatibility"] = {
                "receipt": receipt.relative_to(HERE).as_posix(), "sha256": digest(receipt),
                "log": compat_log.relative_to(HERE).as_posix(),
                "negative_log": negative.relative_to(HERE).as_posix()}
            if ident == "primary":
                entry["negative"] = {"log": row["compatibility"]["negative_log"]}
            MANIFEST.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from pathlib import Path

def put(path, value, *, compact=False):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=None if compact else 2,
                               separators=(",", ":") if compact else None) + "\n")


def digest(path):
    return sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def box(center, half):
    return [[center-half, -1], [center+half, -1],
            [center+half, 1], [center-half, 1]]


def jsonl(rows):
    return "".join(json.dumps(row, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n" for row in rows)


def bundle(base, case_id, branch, target):
    result = deepcopy(base)
    result["case_id"] = case_id
    config_file = next(item for item in result["files"] if item["path"] == "config.json")
    config = json.loads(config_file["content"])
    config.update(selected_case_id=case_id, fire_branch=branch,
                  target_distance_ft=target)
    config["case"]["case_id"] = case_id
    config_file["content"] = json.dumps(config, indent=2) + "\n"
    return result


def diagnostic(base, case_id, branch, target, context):
    spec = deepcopy(base)
    files = spec["files"]
    trace = [json.loads(line) for line in files["trace.jsonl"].splitlines()]
    mapping = [json.loads(line) for line in files["video_frames.jsonl"].splitlines()]
    if len(trace) != 9 or len(mapping) != 9:
        raise ValueError("Pinned diagnostic scaffold changed")
    ego_centers = [(trace[min(index, 4)]["position"]["x"] + min(index, 4) * .3)
                   if branch == "stopped_park" else row["position"]["x"] + index * .3
                   for index, row in enumerate(trace)]
    apparatus_center = ego_centers[-1] + target / 3.280839895013123
    footprints, states = [], []
    for index, frame in enumerate(mapping):
        stopped_ego = branch == "stopped_park" and index >= 4
        footprints.append({"frame": frame["carla_frame"], "time_s": frame["time_s"],
                           "ego_id": "ego", "apparatus_id": "apparatus",
                           "ego_corners": box(ego_centers[index], 2),
                           "apparatus_corners": box(apparatus_center, 3)})
        states.append({"frame": frame["carla_frame"], "time_s": frame["time_s"],
                       "apparatus_moving": False, "ego_moving": not stopped_ego,
                       "ego_following": False, "ego_parked": stopped_ego,
                       "warning_lamp": True, "siren": None})
    files["participant_footprints.jsonl"] = jsonl(footprints)
    files["participant_state.jsonl"] = jsonl(states)
    files["fire_context.json"] = json.dumps(context, indent=2) + "\n"
    capture = json.loads(files["capture/manifest.json"])
    capture["case_id"] = case_id
    files["capture/manifest.json"] = json.dumps(capture, indent=2) + "\n"
    provenance = json.loads(files["fixture-provenance.json"])
    provenance["case_id"] = case_id
    provenance["scope"] = "Synthetic stopped-apparatus software diagnostic; not physical evidence"
    files["fixture-provenance.json"] = json.dumps(provenance, indent=2) + "\n"
    return spec

"""Build the exact authorized-emergency comparison construction."""
from __future__ import annotations

from copy import deepcopy
from hashlib import sha256
import json
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[1]
CASE = HERE.name + "__authorized_emergency_at500"
BASE = HERE.name + "__traveling_follow_500ft"
FOLDER = HERE / "cases/authorized_emergency_at500"


def put(path, value, compact=False):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=None if compact else 2,
                               separators=(",", ":") if compact else None) + "\n")


def digest(path):
    return sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def bundle(original):
    construction = deepcopy(original)
    construction["case_id"] = CASE
    for item in construction["files"]:
        if item["path"] == "config.json":
            config = json.loads(item["content"])
            config["selected_case_id"] = CASE
            config["case"]["case_id"] = CASE
            config["fire_context"]["subject_authorized_emergency"] = True
            config["fire_context"]["subject_official_business"] = True
            config["fire_context"]["alarm_response_source"] = (
                "authored dispatch and official-business scenario premise; verify against retained local Native scene record")
            item["content"] = json.dumps(config, indent=2) + "\n"
        elif item["path"] == "runner.py":
            if item["content"].count('CASE_SUFFIX = "__traveling_follow_500ft"') != 1:
                raise ValueError("Traveling case binding changed")
            item["content"] = item["content"].replace(
                'CASE_SUFFIX = "__traveling_follow_500ft"',
                'CASE_SUFFIX = "__authorized_emergency_at500"')
            before = '_spawn(world, "vehicle.tesla.model3", route["ego"].transform)'
            after = '_spawn(world, "vehicle.carlamotors.firetruck", route["ego"].transform)'
            if item["content"].count(before) != 1:
                raise ValueError("Traveling subject spawn source changed")
            item["content"] = item["content"].replace(before, after)
            item["content"] = item["content"].replace(
                '    if not isinstance(config.get("case", {}).get("recording_description"), dict):',
                '    if context["subject_authorized_emergency"] is not True or context["subject_official_business"] is not True:\n'
                '        raise ValueError("Exception subject requires separately sourced authorization and official business")\n'
                '    if not isinstance(config.get("case", {}).get("recording_description"), dict):')
        elif item["path"] == "tests/test_runner.py":
            item["content"] = item["content"].replace(BASE, CASE)
            item["content"] = item["content"].replace(
                '"subject_authorized_emergency": False,',
                '"subject_authorized_emergency": True,').replace(
                '"subject_official_business": False}',
                '"subject_official_business": True}')
        elif item["path"] == "tests/test_fire_finalizer.py":
            item["content"] = item["content"].replace(
                'runtime = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "runtime"',
                'runtime = next(parent / "runtime" for parent in Path(__file__).resolve().parents '
                'if (parent / "runtime/scenario_pipeline").is_dir())')
    return construction


def main():
    FOLDER.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    manifest_path = HERE / "execution-manifest.json"
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
    base = next(item for item in manifest["cases"] if item["case_id"] == BASE)
    construction_path = FOLDER / "construction.json"
    put(construction_path, bundle(json.loads((HERE / base["construction"]).read_text())))

                             if item["path"] == "config.json"))
    diagnostic = json.loads((HERE / "diagnostic-input.json").read_text())

        capture["case_id"] = CASE
        diagnostic["files"]["capture/manifest.json"] = json.dumps(capture, indent=2) + "\n"
    if "fixture-provenance.json" in diagnostic["files"]:
        provenance = json.loads(diagnostic["files"]["fixture-provenance.json"])
        provenance["case_id"] = CASE
        provenance["scope"] = "Synthetic authorized-emergency software diagnostic; not physical evidence"
        diagnostic["files"]["fixture-provenance.json"] = json.dumps(provenance, indent=2) + "\n"
    diagnostic_path = FOLDER / "diagnostic.json"
    put(diagnostic_path, diagnostic, compact=True)
    relative = diagnostic_path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
    recipe_path = FOLDER / "diagnostic-recipe.json"
    put(recipe_path, {"format": "worker-fixture-recipe",
                      "sources": [{"path": "diagnostic-input.json", "source": relative,
                                   "sha256": digest(diagnostic_path)}],
                      "generator": {"source": relative, "sha256": digest(diagnostic_path)}})
    plan = json.loads((HERE / "case-plan.json").read_text())
    requirement = "authorized emergency vehicle on official business exception to the following-distance restriction"
    source = "NRS 484B.710 full text in inputs/" + HERE.name + "/assignment.json"
    dispositions = plan["requirement_dispositions"]
    match = next((item for item in dispositions if item["requirement"] == requirement), None)
    if match is None:
        dispositions.append({"requirement": requirement, "source": source,
                             "status": "selected_required", "case_ids": [CASE],
                             "evidence_or_gap": "Accepted ordinary-subject summaries do not establish authorization or official business."})
        match = dispositions[-1]
    contract = deepcopy(json.loads((HERE / base["measurement_contract"]).read_text()))
    contract["case_id"] = CASE
    contract["requirements"][0].update(disposition_index=dispositions.index(match),
                                       requirement=requirement, source=source)
    contract_path = FOLDER / "measurement-contract.json"
    put(contract_path, contract)
    entry = {"case_id": CASE, "kind": "delivery",
             "construction": construction_path.relative_to(HERE).as_posix(),
             "construction_sha256": digest(construction_path),
             "measurement_contract": contract_path.relative_to(HERE).as_posix(),
             "measurement_procedure": deepcopy(base["measurement_procedure"]),
             "fixture_recipe": recipe_path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
             "native_handoff": deepcopy(base["native_handoff"]),
             "candidate_risk": {"status": "physical", "reason": "Emergency subject body geometry and official-business premise may fail the matched-distance comparison"},
             "acquisition": deepcopy(base["acquisition"]), "candidates": []}
    for original in base["candidates"]:
        ident = original["id"]
        path = FOLDER / (ident + "-construction.json")
        put(path, bundle(json.loads((HERE / original["construction"]).read_text())))
        entry["candidates"].append({"id": ident, "construction": path.relative_to(HERE).as_posix(),
                                    "construction_sha256": digest(path),
                                    "trigger": deepcopy(original["trigger"]),
                                    "changed_knobs": deepcopy(original["changed_knobs"])})
    proposal_doc = json.loads((HERE / "proposals/cases.json").read_text())
    proposal = deepcopy(next(item for item in proposal_doc["cases"] if item["case_id"] == BASE))
    proposal.update(case_id=CASE, target_type="exception_probe", rationale=requirement,
                    paired_probe_id="authorized_emergency_500_comparison")
    proposal["variable_assignments"].update(
        subject_authorized_emergency={"kind": "scenario_premise", "value": True},
        subject_official_business={"kind": "scenario_premise", "value": True})
    proposal_doc["cases"] = [item for item in proposal_doc["cases"] if item["case_id"] != CASE] + [proposal]
    put(HERE / "proposals/cases.json", proposal_doc)
    next(item for item in plan["cases"] if item["case_id"] == CASE)["construction_status"] = "exact_bundle_pending_proofs"
    put(HERE / "case-plan.json", plan)
    manifest["cases"] = [item for item in manifest["cases"] if item["case_id"] != CASE] + [entry]
    put(manifest_path, manifest)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from copy import deepcopy
from hashlib import sha256
import json
from pathlib import Path


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[1]
PREFIX = HERE.name + "__traveling_follow_"


def put(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n")


def digest(path):
    return sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def once(value, original, replacement):
    if value.count(original) != 1:
        raise ValueError("Expected exactly one selected source edit: " + original)
    return value.replace(original, replacement)


def construction_for(base, target):
    result = deepcopy(base)
    result["case_id"] = PREFIX + str(target) + "ft"
    files = {item["path"]: item for item in result["files"]}
    runner = files["runner.py"]["content"]
    runner = once(runner, 'CASE_SUFFIX = "__traveling_follow_500ft"',
                  'CASE_SUFFIX = "__traveling_follow_' + str(target) + 'ft"')
    runner = once(runner, 'config.get("target_distance_ft") != 500',
                  'config.get("target_distance_ft") != ' + str(target))
    runner = runner.replace('target_gap_ft=500', 'target_gap_ft=' + str(target))
    files["runner.py"]["content"] = runner
    test = files["tests/test_runner.py"]["content"]
    test = test.replace("__traveling_follow_500ft", "__traveling_follow_" + str(target) + "ft")
    test = once(test, '"target_distance_ft": 500',
                '"target_distance_ft": ' + str(target))
    test = once(test, 'config["target_distance_ft"] = 499',
                'config["target_distance_ft"] = ' + str(target + 2))
    files["tests/test_runner.py"]["content"] = test
    config = json.loads(files["config.json"]["content"])
    config["selected_case_id"] = result["case_id"]
    config["target_distance_ft"] = target
    config["case"]["case_id"] = result["case_id"]
    files["config.json"]["content"] = json.dumps(config, indent=2) + "\n"
